Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on A hand writes on the wall. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: whatever they do at home, school and in church. Why did the hand appear on the wall?

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

Example 1: Describe A hand writes on the wall using something at your school.

3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand A hand writes on the wall.
